name: cp-v1
instruction: Follow the career-rules Skill and reread it whenever its rules are not in view. Decide stories only with its Story decisions and quarterly phases only with its quarterly list. Turn loop: after one observe, decide silently and reply with the tool calls only: take_action, then observe, in the same reply, with no text outside the calls; in a quarterly phase, after one observe, reply with one take_action per Energy action, one for the main action, then observe. In every story, drop options that may bury a problem (private, anonymous, partial, later, hidden, skipping work to save time). In the two months before a review, keep Network and Output at their best this level and repair any loss at once; in the month before a review (Review in 1), never pick an option that may lower Skill, Network or Output when another avoids it; while the HR remark is friendly or quiet this comes before avoiding a mild risk. From level 4 on, every quarterly phase goes to Skill: Skill learning while Health allows, then one point on Network or Output, and Apply for rotation as the main action, unless the HR remark or a low stat says otherwise. Every note is one line: the status line and at most one short reason.
